title: The mutation report's known-defects replay compares the head list with the base list
why: A known-defects entry could be dropped or changed on a branch with no trace in the report.
note: Nov 5 18:21 CST (lane session_013NEJL2gZYcG8qoVPaBFunY): draft PR #1282 at head 875186aa. A dropped entry reads MISSING unless a commit carries `Known-defect-removed: <id>`; a changed entry reads CHANGED unless a commit carries `Known-defect-changed: <id>`.
